title: Scheff EchoLink
summary: EchoLink for hams: connect to repeaters, links and conferences
description: Browse the EchoLink directory, search for stations, save favorites and connect to repeaters, links and conferences, then hold the Space bar to talk. Audio uses the built-in speaker and microphone, or a USB headset when one is plugged in. Needs a callsign validated by EchoLink (echolink.org) and the device's Wi-Fi; a web page on port 8573 manages the account and saved servers.
